brief.symptoms: Tests that consume messages with newer fetch API versions or session IDs fail with "insufficient data to decode packet, more bytes expected".
brief.evidence: kafka: insufficient data to decode packet, more bytes expected
hints: The client reports an error after reconnecting.
Look at the offset manager - early-exit path observed in the diff.
When the offset response version is forced to a manual value, downstream packet decoding fails.
brief.lesson: The offset manager must respect the client's requested version; hard‑coding a version breaks protocol decoding.
